S1.identity.name: Product name and selected option
S1.identity.description: Can a visitor read the product name and see which option is selected?
S1.identity.improve: Make the product name and selected size, colour or other option clear on the page.
S1.identity.fullCredit: Readable name, model and selected variant

S1.description.name: Readable product description
S1.description.description: Does the page include a product description that can be read directly?
S1.description.improve: Publish a useful product description as readable page text.

S1.specifications.name: Readable product specifications
S1.specifications.description: Can visitors read the specifications needed to understand this product?
S1.specifications.improve: Show the relevant specifications as readable text, with units where needed.

S1.price.name: Visible price and currency
S1.price.description: Can visitors see the price and the currency they will pay in?
S1.price.improve: Show the verified price and currency for the selected option.

S1.availability.name: Visible stock availability
S1.availability.description: Can visitors see whether the selected option is available?
S1.availability.improve: Show the current availability of the selected option.

S2.entity.name: Product information for search tools
S2.entity.description: Can search and AI tools identify the product from the page’s structured product information?
S2.entity.improve: Add a valid product record that clearly identifies the product on this page.

S2.core-properties.name: Product name, description and image for search tools
S2.core-properties.description: Does the product record include a name, description and image?
S2.core-properties.improve: Include the verified product name, description and image in the product record.

S2.offer.name: Price and stock details for search tools
S2.offer.description: Can search and AI tools read the product’s price, currency and availability?
S2.offer.improve: Add an offer with the verified price, currency and availability to the product record.

S2.identifiers.name: Brand and product identifiers
S2.identifiers.description: Does the product record identify the brand and include the applicable product identifiers?
S2.identifiers.improve: Add the verified brand and applicable manufacturer or global product identifiers. Keep the store’s SKU in its own field.

S2.variants.name: Product options for search tools
S2.variants.description: Can search and AI tools match each product option to its correct offer?
S2.variants.improve: Connect each supported size, colour or configuration to the correct product record and offer.

S3.identity.name: Product name agrees across the page
S3.identity.description: Do the visible product details and the product record describe the same item and option?
S3.identity.improve: Make the product name and option agree in the visible content and product record.

S3.price.name: Price agrees across the page
S3.price.description: Do the visible price and the price supplied to search tools agree for the same option?
S3.price.improve: Match the current price and currency across the visible page and product record.
S3.price.fullCredit: Price and currency agree in same context

S3.availability.name: Stock availability agrees across the page
S3.availability.description: Does the availability shown to visitors agree with the product record?
S3.availability.improve: Match the availability across the visible page and product record for the same option.

S3.optional-claims.name: Product claims agree across the page
S3.optional-claims.description: Do product claims agree wherever they appear in the visible content and product record?
S3.optional-claims.improve: Review the cited claims and make their meaning and scope consistent.

S4.title.name: Clear page title and product heading
S4.title.description: Do the page title and main heading clearly identify the product?
S4.title.improve: Use a clear page title and main product heading that identify this product.
S4.title.fullCredit: Specific title and main product heading

S4.organization.name: Clear headings and specification labels
S4.organization.description: Are product details organised under clear headings with readable labels?
S4.organization.improve: Group the relevant details under clear headings and label the specifications so shoppers can find them.
S4.organization.fullCredit: Clearly labeled sections and readable specifications

S4.image-alternatives.name: Useful product image descriptions
S4.image-alternatives.description: Do informative product images have useful text descriptions for people and tools that cannot see them?
S4.image-alternatives.improve: Give each informative product image an accurate text description. Verify which images need a change in the evidence below.

S5.search.name: Access for search engines
S5.search.description: Does the website allow the search engines checked by this audit to access this product page?
S5.search.improve: Review the website’s crawler permissions and decide which search engines should be allowed to access the product page.
S5.search.fullCredit: Both search crawlers allowed at product URL

S5.ai-retrieval.name: Access for AI answer tools
S5.ai-retrieval.description: Does the website allow the AI retrieval tools checked by this audit to access this product page?
S5.ai-retrieval.improve: Review the website’s crawler permissions against the AI tools you want to allow.

S6.usable.name: Working website sitemap
S6.usable.description: Can the audit find and read a sitemap that helps tools discover the website’s pages?
S6.usable.improve: Publish a readable sitemap containing the relevant website pages.
S6.usable.fullCredit: Retrievable parseable sitemap or index with relevant children

S6.inclusion.name: Product included in the sitemap
S6.inclusion.description: Does the website’s sitemap include the product page assessed here?
S6.inclusion.improve: Include the correct product URL in a readable sitemap.
S6.inclusion.fullCredit: Audited or legitimate canonical URL listed

S7.identity.name: Website identity in the AI guide
S7.identity.description: Does the website’s llms.txt guide identify the business or website?
S7.identity.improve: If you maintain an llms.txt guide, identify the business and website clearly.
S7.identity.fullCredit: Meaningful llms.txt identifies site and purpose

S7.links.name: Useful links in the AI guide
S7.links.description: Does the llms.txt guide link to useful website resources?
S7.links.improve: If you maintain an llms.txt guide, add verified links to the relevant product, category or information pages.
S7.links.fullCredit: Useful working catalog and policy or help links

S8.context.name: Website context for AI tools
S8.context.description: Does the website’s agent guide explain what the business and website provide?
S8.context.improve: If you maintain an agent guide, describe the business and the purpose of its website.

S8.guidance.name: Clear guidance for AI tools
S8.guidance.description: Does the website’s agent guide give tools useful instructions for using its information?
S8.guidance.improve: If you maintain an agent guide, add clear, accurate instructions and links that help AI tools use the website’s information.

C1.identity.name: Product identity
C1.identity.description: Does the page clearly identify the product, brand and model where applicable?
C1.identity.improve: Provide the verified product identity, including brand and model where applicable.
C1.identity.fullCredit: Specific product identity and applicable brand and model

C1.explanation.name: Specific product explanation
C1.explanation.description: Does the description explain this product in useful, specific terms?
C1.explanation.improve: Explain the product’s relevant features and benefits with concrete, verified details.
C1.explanation.fullCredit: Clear complete explanation of product and function

C1.configuration.name: Options and included items explained
C1.configuration.description: Does the page explain the product’s configurations and what is included?
C1.configuration.improve: Describe the available configurations and included items clearly.
C1.configuration.fullCredit: Clear selected configuration and included items

C2.essential.name: Essential product details
C2.essential.description: Does the page provide the essential details shoppers need for this type of product?
C2.essential.improve: Provide the essential product details identified by the findings, including units and scope where needed.
C2.essential.fullCredit: Every applicable essential attribute explicit with required units and scope

C2.supporting.name: Additional useful product details
C2.supporting.description: Does the page include the additional details that help shoppers choose and use this product?
C2.supporting.improve: Add the supporting product details identified by the findings using verified information.
C2.supporting.fullCredit: Every applicable supporting attribute explicit with required units and scope

C3.price.name: Purchase price explained
C3.price.description: Is the price clear for the product and option being assessed?
C3.price.improve: Clarify the price, currency and any conditions for the selected option.
C3.price.fullCredit: Price, currency and material conditions clear

C3.availability.name: Stock information explained
C3.availability.description: Does the content clearly explain the selected option’s availability?

C3.shipping.name: Shipping cost and delivery details
C3.shipping.description: Can shoppers understand the applicable shipping cost and delivery information?
C3.shipping.improve: Provide verified shipping costs, delivery information and the conditions that apply.
C3.shipping.fullCredit: Coverage, cost or calculation and delivery guidance clear

C3.returns.name: Returns policy explained
C3.returns.description: Can shoppers understand the return window, eligibility and important conditions?
C3.returns.improve: Make the applicable return window, eligibility and conditions clear.
C3.returns.fullCredit: Eligibility, window and material conditions clear

C4.intended-use.name: Questions about product use answered
C4.intended-use.description: Does the page answer the relevant questions about how and when to use the product?
C4.intended-use.improve: Answer the product-use questions identified in the findings with specific, verified information.

C4.compatibility.name: Compatibility questions answered
C4.compatibility.description: Does the page answer the relevant questions about what the product works with?
C4.compatibility.improve: Explain relevant compatibility requirements and restrictions.

C4.limitations.name: Product limitations explained
C4.limitations.description: Does the page explain relevant limitations and situations where the product is unsuitable?
C4.limitations.improve: Describe the relevant limitations and conditions identified in the findings.

C4.selection.name: Help choosing the right option
C4.selection.description: Does the page help shoppers choose the appropriate size, fit or other product option?
C4.selection.improve: Add verified guidance that helps shoppers choose the correct option.

C5.consistency.name: Consistent product facts
C5.consistency.description: Do comparable product facts agree within the same product and option?
C5.consistency.improve: Resolve the conflicting facts identified in the findings and verify the correct value.
C5.consistency.fullCredit: No detected contradiction with sufficient comparable evidence

C5.claim-support.name: Evidence for product claims
C5.claim-support.description: Are important product claims supported or clearly qualified?
C5.claim-support.improve: Support the cited claims with relevant evidence or explain the conditions and limits.
C5.claim-support.fullCredit: Material claims have relevant support or qualification
